ns2:section.sectionText: The Human Brain. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery Course. Overview of brain structure and functional organization; sensory, motor and higher cognitive functions; sleep and language; learning and memory; sex and brain; functional imaging; synaptic chemistry and metabolism; drugs and brain function; brain and intelligence; abnormal brain development (Down's syndrome, mental retardation, cerebral palsy); normal and abnormal aging (Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease); neuronal regeneration; neural transplantation. Two hours of conventional lecture/discussion and one hour of audiovisual presentations per week. Readings from popular biological and biomedical science journals and authentic Internet websites. This class will meet in 501 Burrill Hall.
